_comment: Versions to build/mirror per service. CI reads this to drive matrices. v1 scope: core PHP stack.
_note_mariadb: MariaDB upstream only ships a Linux x86_64 generic tarball; linux-arm64/macOS are skipped (use MySQL there).
_note_php74: PHP 7.4 is EOL (since 2022-11); static-php-cli supports it 'unmaintained'. Kept for legacy apps only.
